comments.author: @chaymeeable
comments.text: As a Filipino living overseas, seeing this video makes me joyful and proud! The people of Ibatan and the province of Batanes are one of the most resilient and most honest in the country. I am in support of the strict regulations the province impose on managing tourists. This majestic and peaceful island should remain from mass tourism that can cause destruction in the way the locals live. Also, as a solo traveler, visiting Batanes is one of the things I would like to experience. I have been to Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam, and it's a shame that I haven't been to Batanes, or even Palawan. It is true that one should need a huge amount of money to be able to experience Batanes, specifically the island of Ibatan. But, I think it would be worth the expense. Thank you for showcasing how wonderful and amazing Ibatan is!
